[EN] I succeeded in extracting the power from the Core, although I've barely touched upon its full potential.

The high elves don't realize what they possess. They've grown accustomed to its power—they can't appreciate it.

If I can absorb this power, nothing in the Dream can stop me."That doesn't sound good."
[ES] Logré extraer el poder del Núcleo, aunque apenas he arañado todo su potencial.

Los altelvos no se dan cuenta de lo que poseen. Se han acostumbrado a su poder y no saben valorarlo.

Si logro absorber este poder, nada en el Sueño podrá detenerme."That doesn't sound good."
